title: Reprogramming mouse embryo fibroblasts \(MEF)
protocol: Plate 8x10^6 Plat-E cells per 10-cm dish uniformly.
Culture Plat-E cells in 10% FBS medium for 16 hours to reach 70-80% confluence.
Replace the medium of confluent Plat-E cells with 7.5 ml fresh 10% FBS medium.
For each factor, add 1068 μl ddH2O, 25 μg plasmid, and 156.25 μl 2M CaCl2 to a 15ml tube successively.
Mix vigorously after adding the 2XHBS and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the 2.5 ml mixture into the dish with fresh medium.
Replace the medium of transfected Plat-E cells with 10 ml fresh medium 11-14 hours post-transfection.
Incubate cells after replacing the medium.
Collect supernatant containing virus by syringe and filter through a 0.45 μm filter as the first virus stock, 48 hours post-transfection.
Add 10ml fresh Plan-E medium to transfected Plat-E cells and harvest 24 hours later as the second virus stock.
Thaw frozen Passage 1 OG2 MEFs into a 6 cm dish with MEF Medium in CO2 incubator until confluent.
Split confluent MEFs to P12 or P24 plates at different cell densities.
Adjust the plated density of cells according to the combination of reprogramming factors.
Plate O/K/S/M cells at a density of 1.2-1.5X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate O/K/S cells at a density of 1.5-2 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate KSM/OSM/OKM cells at a density of 1.5-2 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate c-JunDN/K/S cells at a density of 2 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate Jdp2/K/S cells at a density of 2 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate O/SI/d1 cells at a density of 3 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Plate Oct4/Id1/Jhdm1b/Lrh1/Glis1/Sall4 cells at a density of 3 X10^4 cells per well of a 12-well plate.
Mix the virus stock with an equal volume of fresh MEF medium for OKSM induced reprogramming.
Add one volume of fresh MEF medium to the mixed virus stock for OKSM induced reprogramming.
Use a total of 2.5ml (0.5ml each of Oct4, Klf4, Sox2, Myc and fresh MEF medium) per well of 12-well plate for OKSM reprogramming.
Mix the virus stock with an equal volume of fresh MEF medium for OKS induced reprogramming.
Add one volume of fresh MEF medium to the mixed virus stock for OKS induced reprogramming.
Use a total of 2ml (0.5ml each of Oct4, Klf4, Sox2 and fresh MEF medium) per well of 12-well plate for OKS reprogramming.
Use a total of 2ml (0.25ml each of Oct4, Klf4, Sox2 and fresh MEF medium) per well of 24-well plate for OKS reprogramming.
Plate 6x10^6 HEK93T cells per 10-cm dish uniformly.
Culture cells in 10% FBS medium for 16 hours until they reach 70-80% confluence.
Replace the medium of HEK93T cells in a 10-cm dish with 7.5 ml of fresh 10% FBS medium.
Add 1070 μl ddH2O to a 15 ml tube.
Add 12.5 μg pW-TRE-c-Jun/pW-rtTA to the 15 ml tube.
Add 7.5 μg psPAX2 to the 15 ml tube.
Add 5 μg psMD2.G to the 15 ml tube.
Add 156.25 μl of 2M CaCl2 to the 15 ml tube.
Add 1.25 ml of 2XHBS to the 15 ml tube, mix vigorously after addition.
Incubate the mixture for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the 2.5 ml mixture into the dish containing HEK93T cells with replaced medium.
Replace the medium of transfected 10 cm HEK93T cell dishes with 10 ml fresh medium 11-14 hours after transfection.
Incubate the cells further.
Collect the supernatant from the transfected HEK93T cells using a syringe and filter it through a 0.45 μm filter as the first virus stock, 48 hours post-transfection.
Add 10 ml fresh HEK93T medium to the transfected cells and harvest 24 hours later as the second virus stock.
Infect MEFs with virus carrying Oct4, Klf4, Sox2, and c-Jun coding sequences.
Mix 0.5 ml of Oct4 (pMXs-Based Retrovirus) with other components for reprogramming.
Mix 0.5 ml of Sox2 (pMXs-Based Retrovirus) with other components for reprogramming.
Mix 0.5 ml of Klf4 (pMXs-Based Retrovirus) with other components for reprogramming.
Mix 0.125 ml of c-Jun (pW-TRE-Based Lentivirus) with other components for reprogramming.
Mix 0.125 ml of rtTA (pW-Based Lentivirus) with other components for reprogramming.
Mix 0.5 ml of fresh MEF medium with the virus stock mixture for reprogramming.
Add polybrene to a final concentration of 4 μg/ml.
Repeat the infection with the second virus stock 24 hours after the first infection.
At post-infection Day0, replace the virus-containing medium with fresh reprogramming medium such as mES, mES+Vc or iCD1 medium.
Change the medium daily and observe the morphology change.
Count GFP+ colonies at proper days.
